Definition: neuter of the same as G4991 as (properly, concretely) noun; defender or (by implication) defence:--salvation.
BiblicalUsage: Salvation is something seen and something sent. Simeon says, mine eyes have seen thy salvation; Isaiah's word says all flesh shall see the salvation of God; and Paul tells Rome that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and they will hear it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe salvation is not an idea but a sight and a sending, and the Gentiles hearing it is the proof.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
